financialModel.modelProfitLabelZh: 普通股股东税前费用业务收益
financialModel.note: The model uses the issuer-reconciled fee revenue, including its share of equity-method fee businesses. Common pretax earnings equal fee-related earnings attributable to BAM plus investment and other income net of interest. Subtracting cash taxes gives distributable earnings less the stock-compensation addback. All post-reorganization common shares are included; BN ownership and minority interests are not deducted again.
financialModel.noteZh: 费用收入采用发行人已调节的非公认会计准则指标，包括权益法投资的应占费用收益。普通股税前收益=归属于BAM的费用相关收益+扣除利息后的投资及其他收益。减实际现金税后等于可分配收益减股权薪酬加回，保留薪酬成本。包含2025年重组后全部普通股；BN持有73%不再作为少数股东权益重复扣减。合并基金及优先少数股东收益已从应占收益中扣除。
financialModel.excludedCashDebtNote: Owner earnings already include financing costs and proportionate ownership. The model does not add all investments or cash, or subtract consolidated-fund debt and minority interests a second time. Investments whose earnings are included receive no separate asset-value addback.
financialModel.excludedCashDebtNoteZh: 股权收益已包含融资成本及持股比例，不再加回全部投资或现金，亦不重复扣减合并基金债务及少数股东权益。发行人费用收益调节已剔除附带权益等投资收益；纳入收益的投资不再单独加值。

proxies.note: Annual weightedaverage incremental16.3m;Junequarter14.9m, not pointintimeoutstandingawardcount. Uses totaloptions+escrowcombined; no duplicate annualoptiondeduction. 0–2xproxy sensitivity about±1%equitypershare. BNoptionseparateissuerexcluded; restrictedsharesalreadyissued; escrowplans includecancellation.

sources.locator: MD&A Fee Revenues/FRE/DE reconciliation; EPS and stockcompensationnotes; balance sheet totalissuedlesstreasury

cautions: The denominator includes all outstanding BAM common shares after the reorganization, excluding treasury shares. Brookfield Corporation’s ownership of BAM is not another minority-interest deduction. Options on Brookfield Corporation are a different issuer’s shares and are not added to BAM.

The annual 16.3 million incremental diluted-EPS shares serve as a proxy for combined option and escrow dilution, not a reported period-end award count. Zero to twice this proxy tests an effect of roughly 1% on value per share. No separate option-value deduction is applied. Already-issued restricted stock and escrow-share cancellations must not be double counted.

Owner earnings retain stock-compensation costs and already reflect attributable ownership and financing costs. Consolidated fund assets, fund borrowings and minority interests are not added or deducted a second time.

The forecast assumes that each dollar of new required common equity supports $3 of fee revenue. The terminal 25% return applies to new incremental equity, not the entire existing book-equity balance. This lower terminal capital efficiency raises required retention; it does not assume an unfunded jump in the existing capital stock.

Fee revenue and owner earnings are reconciled non-GAAP business measures. The 2022 predecessor year is contextual because the reorganization and bundled compensation addback limit comparability; the 2023–2025 owner-earnings series is directly reconciled.
cautionsZh: 分母包含重组后全部BAM已发行普通股，扣除库存股。Brookfield Corporation持有BAM股份，不构成再次扣除的少数股东权益。Brookfield Corporation期权属于另一发行人，不计入BAM股份。
年度摊薄每股收益所用的1630万股新增稀释股份用于估算期权与托管股份的合计稀释，并非披露的期末奖励数量。将此估算调整为零至两倍，可测试约1%的每股价值影响。不再单独扣除期权价值，也不重复计算已发行限制性股票及托管股份注销。
股东收益保留股权薪酬成本，并已反映应占持股比例及融资成本。合并基金资产、基金借款及少数股东权益不再重复加回或扣除。
预测假定每美元新增所需普通股资本支持3美元费用收入。永续期25%的回报率适用于新增边际股权资本，而非全部现有账面权益。永续期资本效率降低会提高所需利润留存，但不假定现有资本存量在未融资情况下突然增加。
费用收入与股东收益是经过调节的非公认会计准则业务指标。由于重组及合并披露的薪酬加回限制可比性，2022年前身年度仅供参考；2023–2025年股东收益可直接调节。

rationale.growth: Analyst scenario, not management guidance: fade elevated growth toward3% terminal growth.
rationale.growthZh: 分析假设而非管理层指引：较高增长率逐步降至3%的永续增长率。
rationale.targetMargin: Pretax earnings attributable to common owners; recurring SBC stays an expense.
rationale.targetMarginZh: 普通股股东应占税前收益率；持续性股权薪酬保留为费用。
rationale.salesCapital: BAM uses3.0 fee revenue per dollar of incremental common equity, an explicit asset-light fee-business scenario; historical investment balances are not a marginal reinvestment forecast.
rationale.salesCapitalZh: BAM假设每增加一美元普通股资本支持3美元费用收入；这是轻资产业务的显式假设，历史投资余额并非边际再投资预测。
rationale.wacc: This control is cost of equity, not WACC; no enterprise-value bridge.
rationale.waccZh: 该参数表示股权成本，并非加权平均资本成本；不使用企业价值桥接。
rationale.terminalROIC: Terminal return on required common equity governs sustainable earnings retention.
rationale.terminalROICZh: 永续期所需普通股资本回报率决定可持续的利润留存。
